selected_evidence.requirement: Rotate daily and retain seven compressed rotations
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the daily scheduler, installed policy, seven-rotation retention, successful forced rotation, and gzip creation.
Shows an open writer descriptor, unchanged inode through copytruncate, valid archived records, and sequential new records written after rotation.

Captures the healthy pre-restart baseline, reboot acknowledgement, temporary disconnect, changed boot ID, running system, recovered cron service, identical configuration and log hashes, valid archive, and successful post-reboot write.
